pairs.subject: measurement-honesty
pairs.evidence: packages/producers/src/publish/standing.ts:30 The channel standing is folded over at most WINDOW=200 ledger rows. When no success falls inside that window, failuresSinceSuccess is a floor and lastSuccessAt=null cannot tell "never succeeded" from "succeeded before the window". Standing has no field marking the truncation, so consumers print the floor as a total (e.g. pipeline/publish.mts:167 prints "N failure(s) since").

techniques.evidence: packages/producers/src/publish/standing.ts:30 The bound is stated only in the doc comment on line 29 ("or since the window began"). The value that travels carries no truncated or at-least marker, so the floor reaches readers looking like a census.

packages/producers/src/publish/metrics.ts:31 Fields the platform cannot report are null, never 0, and the mechanism is named on lines 28-29. Dry publications get no snapshot instead of a row of zeros (lines 14-15). lib/publish/youtube.ts fetchStats also returns null for withheld ids.

packages/producers/src/publish/adapter.ts:36 Absence survives the adapter seam as null and is persisted unchanged through recordMetric (step 1: preserve absence at every hop). Totals are computed outside this context.

packages/producers/src/publish/metrics.ts:63 A failed platform read returns the error rather than a refreshed count. Dry mode and no-live cases return refreshed:0 with the reason in words (lines 40-46), not a measured zero.

packages/producers/src/publish/metrics.ts:68 The withheld count is incremented in the same loop iteration as refreshed, so the note's "N returned no statistics" can never be larger than the refreshed figure printed beside it.

packages/producers/src/publish/timers.ts:38 The downtime gap is named for the events the instrument can actually see (last heartbeat to the noticing tick) and carries both endpoints as from/to. It makes no claim about when the outage really began.
packages/producers/src/publish/standing.ts:43 Standing produces counts, not rates. The technique explicitly exempts counts, so no floor is owed.

packages/producers/src/publish/metrics.ts:19 This context only appends lifetime snapshots. Deltas, and any decision to announce a change, live in @gt/domain/publication, which is outside this context.
